steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:8090/ in the browser and sign in with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type that password text exactly as given into the password field). Verify you are signed in as admin and report which page you land on.

02-open: Navigate to the project named '{{01-open.first_name}} Project' in OpenProject at http://127.0.0.1:8090/ and open its work packages list. Report the subjects of all work packages whose subject starts with 'Seed:', exactly as displayed on screen, one per line, in the order shown. Do not modify anything.

03-create: In the project '{{01-open.first_name}} Project' at http://127.0.0.1:8090/, create a new work package of type 'Task' with subject exactly '{{runid}} {{01-open.first_name}} Work Package' and a description that includes the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. '{{01-open.first_name}} work package created for run {{runid}}'). Save it. Then report the work package's numeric ID exactly as the app displays it (OpenProject shows it as #<number>), and confirm the subject and description shown on the new work package's page.

04-edit: On the work package page for work package {{03-create.work_package_id}} ('{{runid}} {{01-open.first_name}} Work Package') in {{01-open.first_name}} Project at {{02-open.url}}/{{03-create.url.p3}}, edit the following fields in place (fields become editable when clicked and save automatically): 1) Set the Assignee to the user '{{01-open.first_name}} Assignee' — this is an autocomplete field, so type the name and actually select the '{{01-open.first_name}} Assignee' option from the dropdown that appears; 2) Set the Status to 'In progress'; 3) Set the Finish date to 2026-12-31. After each edit, wait for it to save automatically. Then report the values now displayed on the page for Assignee, Status, and Finish date.

05-add: On the work package page for work package {{03-create.work_package_id}} ('{{runid}} {{01-open.first_name}} Work Package') at {{02-open.url}}/{{03-create.url.p3}}, add a comment to the work package whose text includes '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Comment for run {{runid}}'). Submit the comment. Then report the comment text as it is displayed on the page, and confirm it is visible in the activity/comments area.

06-open: Open work package {{03-create.work_package_id}} in {{01-open.first_name}} Project at {{02-open.url}}/{{03-create.url.p3}} and verify the following, reporting the exact values displayed on the page: (a) the work package's numeric ID as shown (e.g. {{03-create.work_package_id}}), (b) its type, (c) its subject, (d) its description text, (e) the Assignee, (f) the Status, (g) the Finish date, and (h) whether a comment containing the text '{{runid}}' is visible in the activity area (quote it). Do not change anything.
